about_the_game:
Pick up the Pieces,

You hear a loud crash from the other room. One of your Grandma's vases has fallen off the shelf. Mr Stitches' tail sweeps back and forth. Time to get to work.

Take a Breath, Wait for a Sign,

You lay the pieces out in front of you. They are a mixture of shapes, colours and patterns. You shake your head. You can't see it. Mr Stitches leaps down and brushes against your arm. You smile and take a deep breath. A fresh shadow appears before you.

Trust Mr Stitches.

You begin thoughtfully rotating and placing the pieces. You choose the biggest pieces first and start from the corners. Some of the shapes fit together perfectly. But you get stuck. Mr Stitches purrs. He gives you a clue. You place the final piece. Mr Stitches takes care of the rest. The shadows dance around you both.

He is the Kintsugi Cat, after all.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Four seasonally themed stages;

  • 64 unique, hand crafted levels that gradually increase in complexity;

  • Random Level Selector;

  • Hand drawn, minimalist background art and calming music;

  • Simple, intuitive controls. Mouse-only or mouse and keyboard together;

  • Adjustable settings;

  • Hints available in every level.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core or other low-end processor
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: Piece together colourful shards of broken pottery into new designs, then watch as they are fixed together with gold; in this Japanese inspired, Kintsugi themed, 2D jigsaw puzzle game. Test all six angles of rotation as you carefully reimagine your Grandma's vases (with a little help from her cat!).
